findings.where: Screen 7, text and read ("It is 50 V short, so the AVR raises the exciter's field" / "The AVR finds it 50 V short of 440 V")
findings.what: The AVR starts correcting as the load rises, so the trace only dips to about 400-410 V and the AVR never sees a 50 V shortfall; say instead that the load's drop is 50 V, so the AVR raises the exciter's field until the set makes 490 V inside.

The why stops at 'the fault current dies away' without saying why that is bad, so a dying fault current could read as a safety feature; add one plain sentence that the protection needs the fault current held long enough to find and clear the fault (research has AGN124: 'so the load's protection devices have time to clear the fault').

findings.where: Screen 12, question against the Load tile
findings.what: The question says 'the load is 20%' while the Load tile reads 0 until Check; word it 'The load rises from 0% to 20%', as screen 6 does.

'So a small current there controls a much bigger one in the main field' skips where the extra power comes from; bring in the explain's 'The engine turning the shaft supplies the power' and drop a shorter sentence to stay under 90 words.

findings.where: Screen 10, right-Check motion and the AVR's power bar
findings.what: The power bar never shows its point because the output stays at 440 V on every screen; let the answer's motion pull the output near zero so the Shunt bar empties while the PMG bar stays full, or drop the bar.

findings.where: Screen 9 and the explain's supply paragraph
findings.what: The trade is one-sided: PMG gets its benefit, but Shunt gets none; add its plain merit, that it needs no extra machine on the shaft, which the drawing already shows.
The read-through keeps the effect, 440 V falling to 390 V, but drops the cause; add 'The load's current drops voltage inside the machine.'
'Then take off the drop at no load' asks him to subtract a drop that is zero; say 'With no load, there is no drop to take off.'
AVR is never spelled out in the twelve screens and PMG not until screen 9, though both are on the drawing from screen 1; expand AVR once on screen 1 or 3.

findings.where: Screen 7 or the explain's loop paragraph
findings.what: The brief's forward line is missing: synchronising and load sharing work by moving the AVR's set point; one sentence here would set up that later ground without naming lessons.
